risk_tags.relative_only: 相對抗跌：板塊本身仍在下跌
risk_tags.liquidity_concentration: 集中型領漲（流動性代理）

market.narrow_leadership: R20>0 and at least 2 of: B20<50%, LWGAP≥3pp, ≤5 sectors R20>0
market.broad_retreat: R20<0, B20≤35%, B60≤40%, UDVR5≤0.8, ≤3 sectors R20>0; at least 4 of 5
market.stabilizing: R20<0 and at least 3 of: R5>0, ΔB20_5≥10pp, down-volume share falling, fewer 20-session lows
market.rotation_divergence: -3%≤R20≤3%, SDISP≥8pp, ≥2 sectors with A5≥0 and ≥2 with A5<0
market.order: insufficient_data > broad_expansion > broad_retreat > stabilizing > narrow_leadership > rotation_divergence > neutral_mixed

group.cooling: RS20>0, RS60>0, A5<0, and breadth or persistence below its value 5 sessions ago
group.early_improvement: RS20≤0, A5>0, and breadth above its value 5 sessions ago or P10≥50%

concentration.single_issuer_dominance: group mean relative return > 0 and any of: median ≤ 0, mean without the top contributor ≤ 0, state falls from leading/improving without it, removal impact ≥ 3pp
concentration.top3_positive_share: only for groups with at least 6 issuers

thresholds.confirmation: a new state must hold 2 consecutive sessions; insufficient-data sessions freeze the previous confirmed state
